env:rivals.text: The telco towers are thin white lattices on a maroon wall; they read, but are plain. Tint each front tower in its brand colour (Airtel red, Vodafone red, Idea yellow) so the three rivals are told apart at a glance.

env:war_room.text: The map of India is a flat orange slab. Add a thin darker rim (or states as faint lines) so it reads as a map and not a shape, especially in the close Infotel / 95% shots.

env:launch.text: The JIO neon fills the top of every launch shot and covers other text (INSANE, JIOPHONE). Move it 1 m higher and back, or let it appear only from the 'launch' shot and dim it in later beats.

cast:toon_agent.text: Plays the TRAI regulator (behind the desk). With sunglasses he looks like a spy; a plain suit-and-tie official without sunglasses would read better.

shot:infotel.text: 'An unknown company called Infotel': only a '?' and a purple box. A tiny shop with an INFOTEL board (a shopfront shape) would sell 'unknown company' better than a plain box.

shot:circles.text: The 22 pins pop in about a second and are small at this distance. Make the pins 1.5x bigger, or push the camera in during the count.

shot:volte.text: 'Even phone calls travel as data': the packets flying from Mukesh's phone to the 4G tower are small and fast. Slow them down (1.5 s) and make them bigger, so CALL = DATA lands on a visible picture.

shot:old_towers.text: The 2G towers fall like dominoes but are small in frame. Push the camera in ~1.5 m so the fall is the shot.

shot:everyone.text: The DATA oxygen tank beams in over the crowd but sits small at the back. Bring it closer to the camera, or end the shot on a push toward it.

shot:seven.text: 'Seven new customers every second': the 7 phones are tiny white rectangles. Seven toons popping into the front row (one per tick) would be the literal gag from the script note.

shot:insane.text: INSANE is half hidden behind the JIO neon arch. Put it lower, in front of the arch, or drop it (the phone dropping on 'phone' is the picture).

shot:facebook.text: 'For a slice': the cake stays whole. Make the Jio cake two halves (like the RELIANCE cake) and slide a small wedge toward FACEBOOK on 'slice', a callback to the family split.

shot:merge.text: Vodafone and Idea slide together and their crowns drop. Add a 'nervous' sweat drop or a wobble so 'just to survive' has a beat.

shot:today.text: The 524 MILLION counter and the pull-back work. The crowd is only 16 toons; double it for this shot only (a second crowd behind) so the pull-back feels like 'a sea of people'.

shot:loop.text: The bookend works: जियो = LIVE over the opening set, ending on the opening frame. Optionally give Mukesh a JioPhone in hand in this last shot (the opening set, transformed).
